detail.title: Mechanical Accountability in WAKE Architecture
detail.summary: WAKE✳︎ achieves accountability by design: the governance module serves as an immutable, deterministic rulebook that constrains model proposals, while the application store ensures that durable history is only updated through validated intent. This structural bifurcation guarantees that models cannot manipulate their own operating rules or history.
detail.reason: Revising the accountability synthesis to incorporate findings on deterministic governance and record store mutation gating.
